subject: Orchid Therapeutics - request: no-learning commitment, prompt/response custody, and EU transfer evidence
messages:
From: Sara Holmes <sara.holmes@orchidtx.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@orchidtx.com
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: No-learning / prompt ownership / EU transfer evidence request

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the call earlier — quick follow up from Orchid Legal. We need written confirmation and supporting artifacts for the following items before we can complete the procurement loop:

1) A contractual no-learning commitment for our tenant (no model updates or fine-tuning using our data) and a short ops description of how that is implemented (eg. capture controls, flagging, and where data is stored).

2) Clear ownership/entitlement language for prompts and responses originating from our product (we need to ensure our prompts and generated outputs are considered customer-owned and exportable).

3) EU personal data flows: confirmation that EU-subject data can be routed to EU-region inference and, for cross-border flows, that you operate under executed SCCs (please provide the executed SCC letter/manifest and a list of subprocessors with their regions).

4) Minimal evidence: recent audit logs showing no-model-update events for our tenant (last 30 days) and a short runbook for generating these export logs.

We appreciate concise artifacts we can attach to our DPA amendment. Can you point me to the exact files or provide them directly?

Best,
Sara Holmes
Sr. Counsel, Data Privacy | Orchid Therapeutics
[Attachment: orchid_dpa_redlines.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Holmes <sara.holmes@orchidtx.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, david.kim@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: No-learning / prompt ownership / EU transfer evidence request

Sara — thanks, and great to meet earlier. TL;DR: we can meet each ask and I’ve attached starter artifacts. See below for specifics and next steps.

1) Contractual commitment: Redwood can add a DPA addendum clause: "Redwood will not use Customer Content to improve, train, or update any model or model weights unless explicitly agreed in writing (No Model Improvement)." We can scope that to tenant-id ORCH-2026-PROD and include technical enforcement notes.

2) Prompt/response ownership: Customer retains all rights to prompts and generated outputs. Operationally we provide a one-click export of the session transcript and an API endpoint to pull last-90-days interactions; we will include an export statement you can attach.

3) EU residency & transfers: we offer EU-region inference for primary processing. For cross-border fallback we rely on executed SCCs — attached is the SCCs_execution_letter_Orchid.pdf (redacted exec stamp) and a subprocessors snapshot (subprocessors_snapshot_20260928.csv) showing region and role.

4) Evidence & runbook: attached no-learn-ops-runbook.md with commands to produce an audit export and an example audit export for a tenant. We can also produce a tenant-scoped report covering the last 90 days; let us know the time window and we’ll run it.

Attachments included: subprocessors_snapshot_20260928.csv, SCCs_execution_letter_Orchid.pdf, no-learn-ops-runbook.md (stub).

Next steps I propose:
- We’ll run a tenant-scoped audit export for the last 90 days and upload to the secure share by Thu EOD (09/30).
- Marissa (cc’d) will prepare a short DPA addendum language and send a draft tomorrow.
- David (cc’d) to confirm model pinning options (we can pin to a non-adapting model binary for Orchid).

If you need a formal attestation signed by our security team we can include that as well — please let me know the preferred signatory.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Customer Security & Privacy Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: subprocessors_snapshot_20260928.csv (text/csv)]
[Attachment: SCCs_execution_letter_Orchid.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: no-learn-ops-runbook.md (text/markdown)]

From: Tom Lee <tom.lee@orchidtx.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: sara.holmes@orchidtx.com, legal@orchidtx.com
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 10:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: No-learning / prompt ownership / EU transfer evidence request

Tessa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few clarifying asks from our engineering and procurement teams before we accept the addendum:

- Model pinning: we need explicit confirmation which model binary/version will be used when the tenant is pinned, and that the model will not be updated (no hot-patching). Also want to know whether runtime telemetry or gradients are collected that could be used for offline retraining.

- Exportability: the API export option is good. We’d like a sample export (anonymized) showing format and fields, and confirmation that exports include the full prompt+response payload for the transcript.

- Subprocessors: the CSV is helpful — can you confirm if any subprocessors have access to raw transcripts (unredacted)? If yes, we need those subprocessors to be onshore/EU or covered by SCCs for the relevant flows.

- Timeline: procurement needs these artifacts in writing and a simple mutual action plan (MAP) showing milestones and owners — otherwise Finance won’t release the PO.

If you can supply the sample export and a MAP, we’ll aim to move to PO within 10 business days.

Thanks,
Tom Lee
VP Product Operations | Orchid Therapeutics

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Lee <tom.lee@orchidtx.com>, Sara Holmes <sara.holmes@orchidtx.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, david.kim@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: No-learning / prompt ownership / EU transfer evidence request

Tom / Sara — appreciate the specificity. Follow-up and MAP below.

Confirmations (short):
- Model pinning: we can pin you to model v1.4-eu (non-adaptive runtime). No hot-patch policy for pinned tenants; updates are manual and occur only with customer consent. No gradients or training artifacts from your tenant are sent to any training pipelines.

- Runtime telemetry: we capture operational telemetry (latency, token counts) but we do not log model weights or per-request gradients. Telemetry is aggregated and used for service quality only; not for model training.

- Export sample: attached is an anonymized transcript export (example_export_orchid_anon.json) showing prompt/response fields and timestamps. The export includes the full prompt and generated text for each session.

- Subprocessors: subprocessors_snapshot_20260928.csv marks access level. Two subprocessors in EU have read access to transcripts for routing/infra reasons; both are covered by SCCs (see SCCs_execution_letter_Orchid.pdf). We will also provide an attestation signed by our Security Officer confirming no raw-transcript sharing beyond those listed.

Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — milestone owners and due dates: 
- 09/30 EOD (Redwood): tenant-scoped audit export (last 90 days) and anonymized sample export (DELIVERED). Owner: Tessa.
- 10/01 (Redwood): Draft DPA addendum with No Model Improvement clause (DRAFT). Owner: Marissa Cole.
- 10/03 (Orchid): Review DPA addendum and confirm missing items / counter-terms. Owner: Orchid Legal (Sara).
- 10/08 (Redwood & Orchid): Finalize addendum and obtain signatures. Owner: Marissa & Sara.
- 10/10 (Procurement): PO issuance contingent on signed DPA addendum. Owner: Orchid Procurement.

We’ll upload the audit export to the secure share by EOD and route the signed attestation doc through DocuSign if you prefer e-signature. If that MAP works I’ll convert it to a HubSpot task list and invite the stakeholders.

Thanks — assigning Marissa & David internally to execute.

Regards,
Tessa
Head of Customer Security & Privacy Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: example_export_orchid_anon.json (application/json)]
preview: Orchid requests no-learning commitment, prompt/response ownership, SCCs and audit exports; Redwood provides attachments and MAP.
